name: Moons of Peril

mechanics.name: Blue Moon
mechanics.description: The magic moon. It cycles through attacks that leave hazards on the floor and drops its weapon for you to be caught by.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Magic and keep off whatever it has left on the ground.

mechanics.name: Blood Moon
mechanics.description: The melee moon. It closes in, splits itself across the arena, and calls jaguars to join it.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Melee and deal with the jaguars before going back to it.

mechanics.name: Eclipse Moon
mechanics.description: The ranged moon. It raises a shield you cannot damage through and makes copies of itself.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Missiles, break the shield, and work out which is the real one.

mechanics.name: Enraged Moons
mechanics.description: Each moon has an enraged version that hits harder and moves faster.
mechanics.counterplay: Same prayers, less room for error. Bring more supplies than the ordinary version needs.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED, AND THE MOST INFERRED FILE IN THIS BATCH. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). ONE COLLECTION LOG PAGE COVERS THREE BOSSES, so npcIds holds all of them: PMOON_BOSS_BLOOD_MOON 13016, PMOON_BOSS_BLUE_MOON 13017, PMOON_BOSS_ECLIPSE_MOON 13018, plus PMOON_BOSS_ECLIPSE_CLONE 13019 and PMOON_BOSS_ECLIPSE_MOON_SHIELD 13020. The enraged variants 13485 through 13487 and PMOON_BOSS_JAGUAR 13021 detect on npc-spawn. THIS FIGHT SPLITS EACH MOON ACROSS TWO NPCS, WHICH IS WHY EVERY MECHANIC HERE DETECTS ON npc-spawn RATHER THAN AN ANIMATION. The combat npcs 13016 through 13018 carry standing animations but no models at all, while their _VIS siblings 13011 through 13013 carry the models but no animations. An animation trigger is therefore awkward to place with any confidence, and npc-spawn is exact and safe. The cost is that each moon unlocks when it appears rather than when it does anything, which is a fair description of this fight in any case, since meeting a moon is the event. THE MOONS ARE INTERNALLY NAMED DJINN, not moon, so their animation sets are NPC_DJINN_01_*, _02_* and _03_* (10991 through 11020) rather than anything named for this content. Blood Moon and Blue Moon both report standing animation 10999, NPC_DJINN_01_IDLE, and Eclipse Moon reports 11016, NPC_DJINN_02_IDLE, which means the cache does not cleanly separate the first two by animation and is the reason no animation is curated as a trigger anywhere in this file. The previews use those idles anyway, since a preview has no such correctness requirement. THE STYLE-TO-MOON MAPPING IS FROM THE WIKI, NOT THE CACHE: blue is magic, blood is melee, eclipse is ranged. Nothing in the gamevals confirms it. No projectile is curated: the only PMOON spotanims named are unrelated (PMOON_MACUAHUITL_CRUSH 10989 is a player weapon). ALL FOUR PREVIEWS PIN THE SAME MODEL, 52530, which struct 882 frames at zoom 2100 as this page's Combat Achievements entry. That model is Blood Moon's; Blue and Eclipse have their own (52534 and 52529) and should eventually use them. The zoom was raised from 2100 to 2146 to clear the 70px shiftY ceiling BundledBossDataTest enforces. staticFallback is false on all four; whether the idles read has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Moons of Peril', matching 'name'.
